import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 1_000_000_000;
    static final int MOD = 1_000_000_007;
    
    static int[][][][] dist = new int[15][15][15][15];
    static int[][] capacity = new int[400][400];
    static char[][] grid = new char[20][20];
    static char[][] reactions = new char[20][20];
    static final int[] dx = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    static final int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static int iteration = 3;
    static int[] visited = new int[400];
    
    static int N, T;
    
    static int augment(int u, int sink, int flow) {
        if (u == sink) return flow;
        if (visited[u] == iteration) return 0;
        visited[u] = iteration;
        for (int v = 0; v <= sink; ++v) {
            int pushed = 0;
            if (capacity[u][v] > 0 && (pushed = augment(v, sink, Math.min(flow, capacity[u][v]))) > 0) {
                capacity[u][v] -= pushed;
                capacity[v][u] += pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }
    
    static int idx(int x, int y) {
        return (x - 1) * N + y - 1;
    }
    
    static int[][] reachDist = new int[13][13];
    static int[][] tempReach = new int[13][13];
    
    static void propagate(int value) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 13; i++) {
            System.arraycopy(reachDist[i], 0, tempReach[i], 0, 13);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; ++j) {
                if (tempReach[i][j] == value) {
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                        int ni = i + dx[d];
                        int nj = j + dy[d];
                        if (ni >= 1 && nj >= 1 && ni <= N && nj <= N && reachDist[ni][nj] < value && grid[ni][nj] != 'Y') {
                            reachDist[ni][nj] = value;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    static boolean canSpread(int sx, int sy, int tx, int ty, int infx, int infy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 13; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(reachDist[i], 0);
        }
        reachDist[sx][sy] = 1;
        reachDist[infx][infy] = 2;
        for (int step = 0; step < 100; ++step) {
            propagate(1);
            if (reachDist[tx][ty] == 1) return true;
            propagate(2);
            if (reachDist[tx][ty] == 2) return false;
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        int infx = -1, infy = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 15; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 15; k++) {
                    Arrays.fill(dist[i][j][k], 1);
                }
            }
        }
        
        N = sc.nextInt();
        T = sc.nextInt();
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            String line = sc.next();
            grid[i] = (" " + line).toCharArray();
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; ++j) {
                dist[i][j][i][j] = 0;
                if (grid[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    infx = i;
                    infy = j;
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            String line = sc.next();
            reactions[i] = (" " + line).toCharArray();
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; ++j) {
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                    int ni = i + dx[d];
                    int nj = j + dy[d];
                    if (ni >= 1 && nj >= 1 && ni <= N && nj <= N) {
                        if (grid[i][j] != 'Y' && grid[ni][nj] != 'Y') {
                            dist[i][j][ni][nj] = 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int k1 = 1; k1 <= N; ++k1) {
            for (int k2 = 1; k2 <= N; ++k2) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
                    for (int j = 1; j <= N; ++j) {
                        for (int u = 1; u <= N; ++u) {
                            for (int v = 1; v <= N; ++v) {
                                if (dist[i][j][k1][k2] < INF && dist[k1][k2][u][v] < INF) {
                                    dist[i][j][u][v] = Math.min(dist[i][j][u][v],
                                        dist[i][j][k1][k2] + dist[k1][k2][u][v]);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        int source = N * N * 2 + 1;
        int sink = N * N * 2 + 2;
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(grid[i][j])) {
                    capacity[source][idx(i, j)] = grid[i][j] - '0';
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(reactions[i][j])) {
                    capacity[N * N + idx(i, j)][sink] = reactions[i][j] - '0';
                }
                
                if (Character.isDigit(grid[i][j])) {
                    for (int u = 1; u <= N; ++u) {
                        for (int v = 1; v <= N; ++v) {
                            if (grid[i][j] > '0' && reactions[u][v] > '0') {
                                if (Character.isDigit(reactions[u][v]) && dist[i][j][u][v] <= T && canSpread(i, j, u, v, infx, infy)) {
                                    capacity[idx(i, j)][N * N + idx(u, v)] = 1000;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        int maxflow = 0;
        int pushed;
        while ((pushed = augment(source, sink, 1000)) > 0) {
            maxflow += pushed;
            ++iteration;
        }
        
        System.out.println(maxflow);
    }
}
